title: Follow the canvas strategy
coreMove: Create leverage by making other people and the larger work more effective before asking to be central.
sourcePressure: Aspire section: indirect leverage through service. Supported by frozen source sidecar.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing service to being nice or invisible instead of deliberately building the conditions where the work can move.
